notes.title: Released - Hotfix
notes.content:
Greetings, Great Commanders! ♚


◈ Update Details

[Bug Fixes]
-Upgrade tree dark souls count
-HUD overlaps
-Human tier 4 attack
-Undead mage attack


Your reports are essential to improving the game and we’re happy that you guys are with us along the way. Please remember that if you have anything to share, feel free to let us know.

We want to thank all the Commanders who have provided us with bug reports, Your feedback is always appreciated.

Thank you!
